Membership

Become part of a community dedicated to preserving one of Britain's most ancient sheep breeds.

Adult Membership

£15 / year

Full membership for individuals aged 18+

  • Welcome pack
  • Quarterly newsletters
  • Email news updates
  • Free stock listings
  • Free fleece/wool listings
  • Show invitations
  • Annual calendar
  • Members area access
  • Husbandry advice line
  • Studbook registration support

Junior Membership

£10 / year

For members under 18

  • Welcome pack
  • Newsletters
  • Show invitations
  • Husbandry support
  • Members area access
Join Now
Note: You do not have to keep sheep to join the Portland Sheep Breeders' Group. Everyone is welcome.

How to Join

Online Payment

Pay securely online via the button below. You'll receive confirmation and your welcome pack by post.

BACS Transfer

Bank transfer to the Group account. Email us for sort code and account number, quoting your name.

Cheque

Make payable to "Portland Sheep Breeders' Group" and send to the Membership Secretary (address on request).

Direct Debit

Available after your first year's payment. Contact us to set up.
